title: Wyze Camera Event AI Tag Leaderboard
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wyze:event ai_tag=*
| stats sum(ai_tag) as total_value, avg(ai_tag) as avg_value by camera_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks camera values by total and average ai tag across Wyze camera event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `ai_tag` values for each Wyze camera event event and review total and average ai tag by camera.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total ai tag.
grandmaExplanation: It compares your which camera shows the biggest ai tag numbers in your Wyze camera event data.
